run_function_attribute: run the attribute function to predict date and geographical region from text
run_function_restore: run the restore function to perform beam search text restoration with missing characters
run_function_contextualize: run the contextualize function to find similar inscriptions via embedding retrieval
load_dataset_function: load a dataset from a JSON file and return a dictionary keyed by record ID
load_retrieval_function: load pre-computed embeddings from a pickle file and normalize them for retrieval
